Get started: alterecho
Use the menu to start, resume, export and configure conversations.
Settings and histories are independent of the current directory.
JSON, Markdown, TXT and HTML are saved automatically. Ctrl+C preserves history.
Advanced options: alterecho help COMMAND (or COMMAND --help).
Documentation: README.md. doctor never generates; demo uses simulated providers.
